issue.title: Bulk capture templates (@@template:)
issue.description: A draft that starts with `@@template:` captures one item per row from a `{0}`-style template, exactly as if the expanded items had been typed, all or nothing; `bob capture`, the `capture-*` editor protocol, and Bob Mac Capture make templates easy to write, easy to check, and pleasant to read.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/bulk_capture_templates.md requests this work

issue.title: Template language core and bob capture -E
issue.description: language: add the pure template module (framing, placeholders, row lexer, expansion, bounds, issue vocabulary) and its first consumer, `bob capture -E, --expand`.

issue.title: Template execution in bob capture
issue.description: execution: run template drafts through the unchanged planner as N instances, with row-scoped errors, refusals, additive JSON, human summary, help, docs, and the equivalence oracle.

payload.entry: LAND TRIAGE (bob-cli-7w.land): The PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP for the bulk-template decisions strand appears on all five phases (.1 #1, .2 #1, .3 #1, .4 #1, .5 #2). All five are one proposal, filed once as memory task bob-cli-82 (small, ready); the memory_template_decision=no auto-decision means Bryan decides. The .5 #1 'Expand template' Mac editor action (mac_expand_action=no) is filed as feature task bob-cli-83 (medium, ready). Neither has a duplicate or a causally related active epic. Pre-existing macOS CI failures that the epic did not cause (RefsPanelModelTests queued-digit, RefsInspectorScrollTests hosted-short-content) are corroborated with +1 on bob-cli-7p and bob-cli-7h, from run 38807458658. The plan's own 'Out of scope' list (slug filter, per-row bullets, pipe tables, named placeholders, saved templates, implicit templates) was not proposed by any phase, so it was not filed.

LAND VERIFICATION (bob-cli-7w.land): `just check` passes on master f732097c. All 5 phases are closed. Probes against the built bob confirmed -E, execution JSON/human summary, the one-row shape, row prefixes, the equivalence oracle, capture-parse spans/items/needs, the completion gate, the rewrite no-op, the docs, and the glossary strand (the only memory note edited). Remaining epic work, planned as a landing tale that closes this epic: (1) note #1, where Mac Ctrl-J still inserts '- ' in template drafts; (2) Mac CI fails CaptureTemplatePresentationTests.testTemplateRowNeedIsQuietAndUsesBobsDiagnostic (run 38807458658, fake-bob key '@template:' vs the test's '@template:\n'); (3) capture-parse misses marker =<X>/=x session suffixes that execution refuses; (4) capture-parse falsely refuses '{0} %' URL listen templates; (5) 'template:' is offered off line 1 when the text matches; (6) the candidate label is 'Bulk template' instead of the contract's longer label; (7) '@' in a row uses the template-line prefix; (8) execution doesn't report the first issue in draft order; (9) Mac: the cachedRouteCompletion path hides bob's template: candidate; the header-only state is red-underlined; the one-row preview says '1 captures'; the one-row fake-bob key lacks a header; (10) help omits exact arity; two stale #[allow(dead_code)]. Integration: the concurrent commits (ref collections bob-cli-7v, ref rename bob-cli-7x, opaque URL stems) don't touch capture/template code, so nothing needs integrating.

Verified phases .1-.5 against plan:202610/bulk_capture_templates.md and fixed the landing gaps: A1 capture-parse refuses session suffixes on markers with same predicate as execution; A2 capture-parse clipboard follows expanded instances (URL % stays Listen); A3 template: offered only on first nonblank line; A4 label is Bulk template: one capture per row below; A5 @ in row uses template row K prefix; A6 execution reports first issue in draft order with coded errors (no message-text search); A7 help requires exactly one value per placeholder and removed two stale allow(dead_code); A8 docs updated for label/first-line; B1 Ctrl-J inserts plain newline in template drafts via parsedTemplate; B2 header-only test uses @template:; B3 one-row fake-bob key includes header plus model test; B4 @ route completion skips cache so template: appears plus primed-cache test; B5 header-only calm (no underline), singular 1 capture, pickerNeed mentions template_row; B6 Mac label fixture re-recorded. just check passes (second run green after one flaky capture_text failure that passes in isolation); Mac portable-check passes on athena (1209 tests, 0 failures); mac bundle.sh succeeded but just typecheck-tests could not complete because the Mac went offline mid-run, so macOS typecheck is unverified. Follow-ups: bob-cli-82 (decision record), bob-cli-83 (Expand action); pre-existing Mac CI failures +1 on bob-cli-7p and bob-cli-7h. No integration changes were needed: the concurrent commits are ref-library work that does not touch capture.
